meta.title: Atoll Rent a Car — car hire in North Cyprus
meta.description: Rent a car in Kyrenia, Ercan, Larnaca or Paphos. Live availability, clear prices in GBP, free delivery around Kyrenia.

hero.title: Car hire across Cyprus, from our Kyrenia office to every airport
hero.lead: Pick up at Ercan, Larnaca or Paphos, or have the car brought to your hotel. You see which cars are free for your dates before you book.

home.fleetLead: From city hatchbacks to 7-seaters and Land Rovers. Every car has air conditioning.
home.factsTitle: Good to know before you book
home.fact1: Alsancak, Çatalköy, Ozanköy, Karmi and Kyrenia town: we bring the car to you at no charge.
home.fact2: Add South Cyprus cover for £50 per rental and cross at any checkpoint.
home.fact3: Landing in the south? Collect the car at Larnaca or Paphos airport.
home.fact4: The price you see includes the car, discounts and location fees. A small deposit holds the booking; the rest is paid at pick-up.
